name: Strong learner (cohort B: unrecognised errors, neutral learning response)
description: Correct across most equation families; occasional slips. Cohort B: each catalogued misconception is replaced by an error at the same step that OpenPath's teaching taxonomy does not represent (same strength); instruction is understood only from the kind of equations an explanation works through (no title recognition, no misconception targeting).
